answer: Split-tally bond: each identity locks 70 credits, splits its tally at a public vertex. One half stays with the agent; the other files under a plume seal for this tide. An auditor samples a vertex and demands the kept half; halves must sum, and a reused half burns both. Filing: k-th 40+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented halves fail when one vertex holds the same half each tide. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep bonds.
